image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a rough, wet rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates surrounded by a dark, textured girdle. Small green algae and barnacles are visible on the surrounding rock.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is reduced without eyes or tentacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the chiton is visible and blunt; there are no protruding eyes, stalks, or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front of the organism tapers slightly but remains blunt and lacks distinct facial features, matching the description.
The surface appears uniform without any obvious sensory organs like antennae or complex eye spots.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Exactly eight distinct plate segments are visible running from head to tail, overlapping in the correct anterior-to-posterior direction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A dark, thick border surrounds the plates. It appears textured and leathery, consistent with a chiton girdle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a mottled pattern with shades of grey, white, and hints of green/brown, fitting the natural variation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a dorsal perspective; the ventral side (foot) is pressed against the rock and completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The chiton conforms tightly to the irregular surface of the rock, showing a low-profile, flattened appearance typical of adhesion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability, not a static visual feature. The animal is currently extended and adhered, not curled.
